      Parameters:
      name - The name of the new employee
      role - The new employee's role in the company (Cashier, Manager, etc.)
      payText - The new employee's hourly pay
      startText - The new employee's start date
      endText - The employee's end date (if applicable)
      Returns:
      New employee Object, with the parameters as its values
